label: Date and time
description: An exact instant in time, stored in UTC and displayed in the viewer's own time zone, such as when a ticket was resolved or an outage started. Use date for calendar dates that should not shift between time zones.
usage: Set platform-maintained timestamps from workflow transitions (set: { resolved_at: "now()" }) and make them read-only.
In lists, show relative times only alongside the absolute time.
constraints: Values are RFC 3339 UTC instants ending in Z with second precision (e.g. 2026-10-10T14:30:00Z); other offsets are converted to UTC on write.
Displayed in the viewer's time zone with its abbreviation; relative times ("2 h ago") always carry the absolute time in a tooltip.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Type a date and time in the locale format, or Alt+Down opens the picker (calendar grid plus time input); Enter selects, Esc closes.
accessibility.notes: The viewer's time zone is stated next to the input and in the accessible description.

responsive: Date and time inputs sit side by side on desktop and stack below 720px.

examples.description: Resolution timestamp set by the Resolve transition
